name: applications
label: Applications
description: An array of available applications

name: domains
label: Domains
description: An array of available domains

name: userScope
label: User scope
description: An object containing the id and label of the user's current scope

name: userDomain
label: User domain
description: An object containing the id and label of the user's current domain

name: currentUser
label: Current user
description: An object containing the currently logged in user

name: supportDomains
label: Support domains
description: True if we support showing the domain information

name: supportScope
label: Support scope
description: True if we support showing the scope information

name: isDomainExpanded
label: Is domain expanded
description: True if the user has expanded to view all domains

name: requestScopeId
label: Record scope id
description: The sys_id of the scope of the record

name: requestScopeName
label: Record scope name
description: The name of the scope of the record

name: requestDomainId
label: Record domain id
description: The sys_id of the domain of the record

name: requestDomainName
label: Record domain name
description: The name of the domain of the record

name: requestPageDefinitionScopeId
label: Macroponent scope id
description: The sys_id of the scope of the macroponent record (pages only)

name: requestPageDefinitionScopeName
label: Macroponent scope name
description: The name of the scope of the macroponent record (pages only)

name: recordProtectionPolicy
label: Record protection policy
description: The value of the policy field of the screen record

name: pageDefProtectionPolicy
label: Macroponent protection policy
description: The value of the policy field of the screen record (pages only)

name: isSharedPageDef
label: Is shared page definition
description: True if this is a legacy template record

name: requestItemType
label: Request item type
description: The name of the kind of record we are editing

name: size
label: Size
description: Either sm or md, where sm has the buttons underneath the message and md has them to the right

name: allowCancelTransactionInProgress
label: Allow canceling transacting into scope
description: True if a user can cancel transactiong into a scope (e.g. when there are unsaved changes)

name: userRoles
label: User roles
description: Array of roles that the current user has

name: overrideActionDisabled
label: Disable creating screen overrides
description: True if users should not be able to create screen overrides (set to false by Pages only)

name: noMargin
label: No margin
description: True if the alert banner should not have added margins
